## Situation

The quickstart journey offered by ValidMind before I joined was simply put, not very quick, and not very helpful in getting you started:

- Our solution was for developers, validators, and auditors, but the only guidance available was for developers.
- Most of the information was conceptual, not action-oriented, bombarding users with walls of text.
- Any action-oriented info was scattered into multiple guides, asking users click many links before starting tasks.

## Solution

A cleaned-up, uncluttered quickstart portal with no fluff:

- Quickstart journeys for all roles, each presented with explicit learning outcomes to set expectations.
- Quickstarts are only action-oriented, and consolidated into a single guide for each role. 
- Show, and not tell — value is demonstrated through interaction with the product, not through conceptual text.

::: {.callout}
## Along with redesigning the quickstart experience, I also owned the content of each quickstart in its entirety.

For the developer and validator quickstarts, I also authored the Jupyter Notebooks used in those journeys.
:::

::: {.column-margin}
:::{#validmind-jupyter}
